lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Standard field lines are above tracks and below point groups
value.statement: Match only line or multiline geometry named Полевые линейные or field_lines (trimmed, case-insensitive). Keep whole body/halo/icon/label groups above ordinary data and every saved/current track pass and below actual Point/MultiPoint groups across full/lite/style/source/data/private refresh/reorder. Resolve exact logical, style-controller current native and known line-label aliases without stale-generation/prefix guesses; polygon Point label anchors never acquire point priority. Take relative group order from canonical bottom-to-top flattened LayerGroup, never source-cache insertion or registration arrival. Preserve internal order, cached Style.getLayer wrapper/filter-owner identity and higher transient tools/GPS; an already-correct stack is unchanged. Display priority never filters hit candidates or modifies cache/queue/currentness or authoritative data. The new sqlite-priority native corpus covers direct root children; nested/recreation acceptance remains separate.
